name: awp-playbook-aivideo-explainer
description: Explainer video Skill for AI agents: make long videos that hold up past the first minute.

plugins.name: explainer-video
plugins.description: Make long explainer videos with your agent in eight steps: lock the narration and one look, delegate each segment to a fresh sub-agent, watch the cut like a viewer, polish it in a fresh session, and fine-tune the Skill in a retrospective. Remotion + FFmpeg, runs locally.
